fact: Kenya's 2026 digital identity playbook lists KRA tax, SHA/SHIF health, education systems, financial-sector e-KYC, SIM registration, immigration and social protection systems as connected to the population register, with an e-KYC platform verifying identities for public and private transactions.
title: The Kenya Digital Identity Playbook: Identity as Foundation of Digital Public Infrastructure
publisher: Republic of Kenya, State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services (ID4Africa AGM 2026)
